notes: Aircraft icons, air patrols & a slower clock

New aircraft icons: fighters with swept wings and twin tails, the straight-winged A-10 with its rear engine pods, four-engine props for C-130s, P-3s and gunships, a swept-wing KC-135 tanker with its boom, the long-winged B-52, and a slim Predator. Carrier strikes now fly jets, not carriers

Daily air patrols: tap the map and choose Fly a daily air patrol here. Tankers fly a refueling track (jets at bases within about 950 km reach 650 km farther). Fighters, A-10s and gunships fly CAS orbits that break troops in contact and spoil ambushes. Drones and P-3s fly ISR orbits that find strongholds and IEDs. Each costs a little every day

The clock is slower: 1× is now 10 minutes per game day (it was about 2½). The speed ladder now goes up to 256×, so the top speed is as fast as before. Your saved speed is converted so the pace you were playing at stays the same
